corrected_fields.summary: This is a Federal Reserve navigation page listing historical regulatory amendments related to primary and secondary credit rate changes at Federal Reserve Banks, spanning from 2008 to December 2025. The page is not a single archiveable document but rather a chronological index of individual notices documenting rate increases and decreases.
corrected_fields.why_it_matters: This page serves as an authoritative index for Fed discount window rate history. However, it contains no new analytical content and individual rate decisions must be accessed via linked PDFs.
corrected_fields.market_structure_context: This page documents historical changes to the Fed's primary credit (discount window) rate and secondary credit rate. These rates are part of the Fed's lending facilities that serve as backstops to the banking system.
